findings: All three cases passed with the published 0.28.0.
ext4-degraded: the NAS reported volume_failed while mdadm had not yet started the array with one disk missing; fixed for 0.28.1 by a three-minute start grace in the notification watcher.
limits: QEMU virtual disks and USB stick only; no real hardware.
